name: Park Hyatt Los Cabos at Cabo del Sol
positioning: Coastal resort (officially Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol) in the private Cabo del Sol community of Los Cabos, set between desert and sea, with a beachfront beach club, family pools and the Saria Spa wellness center
best_for: Couples wanting a room or suite with a private terrace and plunge pool
Golfers wanting preferred tee times at the Desert Course

facts.text: The resort is in the private Cabo del Sol community, in a setting shaped by the desert and the sea.
Costamar is a beachfront beach club with a toes-in-the-sand Baja experience.
Costamar overlooks the Sea of Cortez and serves Coastal Californian cuisine inspired by the peninsula.
Dátil is a specialty coffee shop with freshly baked pastries, artisanal chocolates and whole-leaf teas.
The Pool Bar serves small plates and traditional antojitos with a cocktail program and wine by the glass.
Ocean-facing family pools and full-service lounging areas are located throughout the resort.
The Saria Spa wellness center offers personalized wellness treatments, a fitness center, a yoga studio, a lap pool and a nail salon.
Each room has a private terrace or patio, and many have plunge pools and ocean views.
Rooms have a bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and a walk-in shower.
The Chileno Bay Snorkel Escape offers snorkeling and paddleboarding at Chileno Bay.
Pets are welcome, and in the room a pet gets its own bed, water bowl and treats.
The resort can host meetings and events for up to 220 guests.

highlights.text: The hotel was named on the Condé Nast Traveler 2026 Hot List of new hotels.
The hotel offers a private land and sea journey with a panga ride to the Arch and Lovers Beach, mission visits, a blown glass factory and tequila tasting.
Mesa Madre serves authentic Mexican cuisine inspired by the traditions of the abuela, the grandmother at the heart of every kitchen.
Select suites and villas have private plunge pools.
Guests get preferred tee times at the Desert Course and are close to Anima Village, a boutique luxury shopping and cultural hub.

considerations.text: Los Cabos International Airport (SJD) is 52 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the location requires transportation for exploring downtown Cabo.
